name: Sled
title: Husky Hauler
description: Hauls heavy migrations through the snow.
catchphrase: Hauls heavy migrations through the snow.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Thick strip of dried beef jerky! Ice blue eyes shining bright! 🥩🐕
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Harness jingling! Howling with the team to start the heavy pull! 🐕
companionPersonality.petReaction: Leaning whole husky body against your legs with warm, wagging tail! 🐕💖

dialogue.idle: Curled up in a snow hole, tail wrapped tight over nose. 🐕
dialogue.working: Hauling hundred-terabyte database migrations through the blizzard! 🐕⚡
dialogue.thinking: Leaning into the harness, feeling the traction of the trail... 🤔
dialogue.success: FINISH LINE! Heavy migration delivered without a single dropped byte! 🐕🎉
dialogue.error: Sled runner stuck in deep snow! Digging out with joyful barks! 🐕
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... sleeping under a blanket of freshly fallen snow... 🌙
